_how: crushcheck.py rule: a color is lifted only if chroma C* >= c_min (it is a color, not a black/gray) AND L* < l_crush (the press cannot show its hue). Lifted colors go to L* = l_fix, same hue. Everything else is untouched.
_calibrate: python3 crushcheck.py --swatches versant_swatches.pdf, print it on the Versant on normal stock, find the lowest L* row where every hue still reads as a color next to its neutral, set l_crush to that row and l_fix about 6 above it.
calibrated: 2026-09-25 — swatch sheet printed on the Versant: rows L*10–20 crushed to black, L*22 was the lowest row where every hue still read. l_crush 22, l_fix 28.
